draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and focused on the practical task of getting somewhere
notes: 车站 is a general term for both bus stops and train stations.
For larger, major train stations, you may also hear 火车站 (huǒ chē zhàn).
While 站 (zhàn) by itself can mean 'station', 车站 explicitly combines 'vehicle' and 'station' to clarify that it is a transit stop.
